material_rules.note: the 120 deg directional gradient and the chromatic impact ripple are material work on MI_EBS_MER_ShieldField; no geometry implements them

material_slot_policy: 4 slots. FRAME: charcoal machined frame, hubs, hinges, treads AND the six opaque cell back plates that stop the field and the pane rims ever reading from behind the unit. CERAMIC: pale plates. SHIELD FIELD: the six cell field slabs only. STATUS CYAN (full list, no omissions): two operator visors, the emitter lens, the six cell pane rims, the chassis bay core and the two flank conduit lines - the bay core and the conduits are the reference's own machined-conduit glow and are 26.7 percent of the cyan area. The six pane rims must light and darken WITH the field material, not with the status channel (README section 8 deviation 15). The card sets no slot ceiling; brass edge trim, scuff noise and the team mask are texture channels of the ceramic slot.

packed_state.packed_flank_field_note: The barrier field slab cannot be removed from the packed pose by geometry: the rig is rotation and translation only (ebs_skelkit.Keyframe has no scale track), so a rigid 62 x 260 cm pane is present in every pose, and the packed fold turns each pane's FRONT face outboard, i.e. the flank camera looks straight down the pane normal. The packed read therefore depends on the field material being OFF while packed - the state baked into the packed_field_dark review assembly. README section 8 records the deviation.

rig.bone_count_note: the card requires 18; the fidelity file's prose list enumerates 16. The emitter and shield_anchor bones carry the remaining two and each drives a named socket (README section 8).

bones.name: chassis
bones.purpose: wide low two-operator chassis; carries every other bone

bones.name: shield_anchor
bones.purpose: deployed face centre; drives Shield_Face_Center, the impact ripple origin and the cover volume

rig.policy: identity rest orientation; the rest pose is DEPLOYED; the packed state is the wing-root yaw+translate pose (PACK_YAW/PACK_T); no root motion; the impact ripple and the 120 deg gradient are material work on the field slot, not geometry

stage_boundary: Concept-matched deployed rest geometry, 18-bone transformation rig, keyframed clip data and the packed state as a posed review assembly; no textures, no import, no gate acceptance, no owner acceptance. The deployed rear read is geometry (opaque pane back plates, measured 0.0 percent barrier field frontmost from -X); the packed flank read is a runtime material requirement, measured and recorded as README section 8 deviation 16.
